operations.name: read_device_id
operations.desc: Read the PCI device ID via configuration space
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, 0x80000000
out dx, eax
mov dx, 0xCFC
in eax, dx
ret

operations.name: read_vendor_id
operations.desc: Read the PCI vendor ID via configuration space
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, 0x80000000
mov dx, 0xCF8
out dx, eax
mov dx, 0xCFC
in eax, dx
and eax, 0xFFFF
ret

operations.name: read_class_code
operations.desc: Read the class code and revision ID
operations.returns: Class code in upper 24 bits, revision in lower 8 bits
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, 0x80000008
mov dx, 0xCF8
out dx, eax
mov dx, 0xCFC
in eax, dx
ret

operations.name: read_command_register
operations.desc: Read the command register to check enabled features
operations.returns: Command register value (bit 0: IO space, bit 1: memory space, bit 2: bus master)
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, 0x80000004
mov dx, 0xCF8
out dx, eax
mov dx, 0xCFC
in eax, dx
and eax, 0xFFFF
ret

operations.name: read_status_register
operations.desc: Read the status register to check device state
operations.returns: Status register value indicating capabilities and error conditions
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, 0x80000004
mov dx, 0xCF8
out dx, eax
add dx, 2
in ax, dx
ret

operations.name: read_header_type
operations.desc: Read header type to determine device configuration space layout
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, 0x8000000C
mov dx, 0xCF8
out dx, eax
add dx, 4
in al, dx
and al, 0x7F
ret
